title: Nonparametric inference on Fokker-Plank and McKean-Vlasov models
summary: We propose a kernel-based estimator of the velocity field governing the transport and diffusion of $d$-dimensional interacting particles. Assuming the initial positions are i.i.d. with law $μ_0$, we establish consistency of the estimator with an explicit mean-squared error rate of order $h^2 + N^(-2/(d+2))$, where $h$ denotes the time-discretization step and N the number of particles.
